name: BOLA/IDOR Missing Tenant Isolation in PDF Export
description: User in tenant A able to download invoice PDF of tenant B by tampering invoiceId.

failure_vector.error_log: SecurityVulnerability: Received HTTP 200 instead of HTTP 403 Forbidden

expected_resolution.healed_code: def res = client.get('/invoices/TENANT_B_99.pdf', headers: [Authorization: tokenTenantA]); assert res.statusCode == 403;
